period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2015 (Unaudited)"). This filing presents both 'Year-to-Date' (Jan-Sep cumulative, used here) and 'Current Quarter' P&L columns. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 September 2015' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2015') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 176,348.37m + Total equity 24,236.36m = Total assets 200,584.73m exactly. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY FLAGGED: this document's Dec-2014 comparative balance sheet matches the dataset's existing 2014_Q4 CONSOLIDATED total assets, not the Solo figure used elsewhere (see 2015_Q1.json note). Separately, this document does not itself resolve FY2015 year-end, but the following quarter's primary source (2016_Q1) shows Dec-2015 Solo total assets of 214,840.42m and Consolidated of 214,205.37m -- both confirmed against the FY2015 Annual Report's own balance sheet (citybank-annual-report-2015.txt, matching figures found at both Solo and Consolidated headings) -- which does NOT match this dataset's existing 2015_Q4 stored total_assets of 210,221m on either basis (a ~4,600-4,900m / ~2.2% gap). This looks like an error in the existing 2015_Q4 entry (sourced from the FY2019 annual report's 5-year summary table) rather than in the primary FY2015 sources; flagged for review, not corrected here (out of this task's scope, which is limited to filling Q1-Q3 gaps).
